title: Technical Operations Engineer (Voice & Integrations)
description:
Vozy es el sistema para resoluciones de cliente - la plataforma donde los agentes de IA y los equipos humanos comparten memoria, gobernanza y resuelven como uno. Diseñado para transformar la experiencia al cliente con agentes de IA.
Somos un equipo diverso y talentoso distribuido en varios países, y estamos buscando un Technical Operations Engineerpara sumarse al area Customer & Product Success (CPS), el dominio donde la tecnología se encuentra con el cliente y donde Lili y el equipo humano resuelven como uno.
Misión del Rol
Garantizar que la infraestructura técnica del lado del cliente funcione (telefonía, conectividad, integraciones, activaciones) y ser el puente de resolución técnica entre CPS y Platform.
Este rol resuelve los problemas que no son del agente conversacional ni de la plataforma core, sino de la capa intermedia que conecta a Vozy con el cliente. Sin este trabajo, los agentes que despliegan los FDEs simplemente no llegan al usuario final.
Lo que harás en:
1. Telefonía y conectividad

• Configurar, migrar y sostener troncales SIP de clientes y de Vozy : esquemas de carrier global, carrier por cuenta, troncales por Internet y por VPN.

• Diagnosticar fallas de marcación y de audio con trazas SIP y capturas de paquetes: rechazos por código 480, congestión de circuito, timeouts de timbrado, transferencias sin respuesta, invites duplicados sobre una misma llamada, audio que llega degradado desde el carrier.

• Gestionar DIDs, prefijos, enmascaramiento y matrices de enrutamiento por país, y validar por qué ruta entra el tráfico antes de configurar.

• Interlocutor directamente con carriers y con los equipos de telefonía de los clientes hasta el cierre del caso, con evidencia técnica en la mano.

• Sostener pruebas de telefonía en ventanas acordadas con cliente, incluyendo pruebas por país, numeración local y reversión de troncal al terminar.

2. Activaciones e integraciones

• Ejecutar la activación técnica de clientes nuevos: troncal SIP, conectividad, VPN, listas de IP, webhooks, SFTP y buckets de almacenamiento.

• Provisionar y migrar canales de mensajería: creación de cuenta con el proveedor de WhatsApp Business API, conexión con el Business Manager del cliente, onboarding de números y validación de saldo y estado de cuenta.

• Validar integraciones con las centrales telefónicas y contact centers del cliente, y armar la lista de chequeo de requisitos técnicos antes de cada integración.

3. Soporte y escalamiento

• Ser el primer punto de escalación técnica para FDEs y clientes en temas de telefonía e integraciones.

• Triage de tickets: exigir la información mínima (identificador de sesión, cuenta, agente, campaña, fecha y hora, evidencia) antes de investigar, y devolver lo que llegue incompleto.

• Escalar a Platform e infraestructura con contexto y propuesta, nunca con un "algo no funciona": qué falla, en qué cuenta, qué se descartó y cuál es la hipótesis.

• Sostener la operación durante incidentes que afectan a varias cuentas a la vez, coordinando comunicación con FDEs y liderazgo.

4. Monitoreo y prevención

• Construir y operar monitoreo proactivo de la capa técnica: tableros de llamadas rechazadas por cuenta, estado de troncales, saldo de canales, salud de los flujos.

• Anticipar problemas recurrentes y proponer solución preventiva. Hoy varios incidentes se detectan porque el cliente los reporta, no por alerta propia. Cerrar esa brecha es parte del rol.

• Automatizar detección y respuesta a degradación, no solo alertar.

5. Documentación y formación

• Mantener runbooks de soporte técnico y activaciones para los escenarios más comunes.

• Entrenar a FDEs en troubleshooting básico de telefonía e integraciones, con sesiones prácticas sobre casos reales.

• Documentar patrones de problema y solución reutilizables, incluyendo el inventario de carriers y rutas como fuente única.

Qué se espera en los primeros meses

• 30 días. Accesos completos y autonomía en diagnóstico de primer nivel: leer una traza SIP,

AI Fearlessly.

Your mission is to move beyond reactive troubleshooting to become a Trusted Advisor , ensuring customers achieve measurable cybersecurity resilience. You will lead the technical journey for our most strategic accounts, transforming complex security requirements into scalable, operational successes within the TrendAI Vision One™ ecosystem.

•
Outcome-Driven Management: Act as the primary technical voice post-deployment, shifting the focus from "ticket resolution" to "security outcome attainment."

•
Success Planning: Contribute technical milestones to the broader Customer Success Plan, ensuring a clear roadmap for platform adoption, version upgrades, and feature deployments.

•
Platform Mastery: Conduct regular architectural reviews and configuration audits to ensure customers are utilizing the full breadth of the TrendAI platform.

2. Proactive Operations & Enablement

•
Value Realization: Guide clients through a structured onboarding and deployment process, ensuring rapid time-to-value and high feature utilization.

•
Technical Workshops: Design and deliver bespoke workshops and "Best Practice" sessions to mature the customer's internal SOC and SIEM operations.

•
Advanced Threat Defense: Provide technical oversight during critical security events, offering proactive recommendations to harden the customer's posture against evolving threats.

3. Operational Excellence & Leadership

•
Root Cause Strategy: Perform deep-dive root cause analysis (RCA) on complex issues, providing long-term strategic recommendations to prevent systemic failures.

•
Cross-Functional Orchestration: Serve as the regional liaison between the customer and internal Product Engineering, R&D, and Sales Engineering to influence product roadmaps.

•
Account Health Integrity: Maintain a "Single Source of Truth" for account health, including detailed environment maps, troubleshooting playbooks, and operational reports.

SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

•
Language: Fluent in written & spoken English & Spanish, Portuguese is an advantage

•
Experience: 10 or more years of experience in technical support, security architecture, systems engineering, or a relevant client-facing consulting field.

•
Domain Expertise: Strong knowledge of security frameworks (NIST, MITRE ATT&CK), SIEM/SOC operations, and endpoint/network defense technologies.

•
Technical Depth: Deep understanding of multiple operating systems (Windows Server, Linux, Solaris) and hybrid-cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP).

•
Strategic Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to articulate complex technical risks in simple, business-centric terms for executive stakeholders.

•
Analytical Mindset: Highly process-oriented with a passion for digital organization, documentation, and technical reporting.

title: Head of Marketing, APJ
description:
ABOUT EXA

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders & dropouts alike.

We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

We are looking for a Head of Marketing, APJ based in Sydney to lead Exa's marketing across Asia Pacific and Japan.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is Exa's first senior marketing leader outside the United States. You will set the marketing strategy for Asia Pacific and Japan and run it as a commercial function, tied to the region's pipeline number. APJ is many markets with different buyers, languages, and routes to market. Deciding which ones matter first, and how Exa wins in each, is the core of the job.

Sales coverage is coming online across ANZ, Southeast Asia, and India, with a partner-led motion in Japan. You will be the marketing counterpart: deciding where to invest, which motions to run in which markets, and how a fast-moving American AI infrastructure company earns credibility with buyers in Sydney, Tokyo, Singapore, and Bengaluru.

This is a player-coach role. You will write the regional plan and then help execute it yourself, from shaping a campaign and adapting the message to hosting an executive dinner and sitting in pipeline reviews with Sales. You start as a team of one, with meaningful budget for field events, conferences, and developer events. We expect your first hire, an early-career field events marketer, to join within months, with more headcount as growth justifies.

Exa's buyers are technical, and much of our growth starts with developers who sign up and build before anyone talks to Sales. The right person understands both product-led growth with developers and account-based programs for enterprise buyers. You will work closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing to keep all of it pointed at the same priorities.

This is an AI-first role at an AI-first company. Account research, localization, campaign analysis, and reporting should be workflows you build, since one person covering a dozen markets only works if the work is automated.

This role is based in-person in Sydney, with regular travel across APJ and periodic trips to our San Francisco HQ.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

APJ MARKETING STRATEGY

Own the regional marketing plan. Translate Exa's global priorities into a plan for APJ, prioritize markets by opportunity and sales coverage, and decide where to invest across markets and programs. Own the APJ marketing budget, which centers on field events, conferences, developer events, and selective local sponsorships (including developer creators and communities). Success is measured by revenue growth.

GO-TO-MARKET BY MARKET

Build a go-to-market approach for priority markets across ANZ, Japan, Southeast Asia, and India. The right motion differs by market (direct, partner-led, or channel-based), and some markets should wait until product-led signal justifies the spend.

PIPELINE AND DEMAND

Own APJ pipeline targets. Build the programs that create qualified opportunities and move them through the cycle: account-based campaigns, executive dinners, a small number of high-value trade shows, reactivation of any stalled pipeline, and webinars or localized content. Use pipeline and conversion data to shift investment toward what works. Success is measured by pipeline and by cost per opportunity.

SALES PARTNERSHIP

Be the marketing partner to APJ Sales, SDRs, and regional partners. Align on ICP, target accounts, campaign priorities, lead routing, and follow-up

Ceci est mis en pratique par la représentation, la modélisation et l’analyse des données de ces organisations afin de formaliser de la connaissance conduisant à la prise de décision dans des contextes hétérogènes, collaboratifs, incertains et/ou perturbés.
Le CGI est structuré selon des axes de recherche appliquée et des programmes scientifiques. Les axes de recherche appliquée sont :

• Axe FLOWS : Flexible Logistics and Operations for sustainable WorldS dans lequel ce poste est rattaché .

• Axe DiSCS : Digital Systems for Crisis management and Security ;

• Axe TRACE : Territorial Resilience, Agility, and Circular Economy ;

• Axe WHOPS : Well-being and Health through Organizational Processes and Services .

Les deux programmes scientifiques au cœur de ces axes de recherche sont :

• HOPOPOP : Hybridization for Operations & Planning, Organizations & Performance, Optimization & Problem-solving ;

• AIME-DM : Automated Information Modeling and Extraction for Decision-Makers .

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :
Dans le contexte de l’Education 4.0, les différents acteurs d’un établissement de formation universitaire (étudiants, personnels, intervenants extérieurs, etc.) ont des contraintes et des objectifs différents ce qui rend complexe la coordination et le pilotage de tels établissements (organisation et planification des enseignements, gestion des espaces collectifs, organisation des sessions d’examens…).
En complément, ces établissements doivent s’adapter tant sur la gestion de leurs sites (meilleure adéquation à de nouvelles formes pédagogiques) que sur les flux de personnes les utilisant pour une meilleure répartition des charges et une interopérabilité de tous les outils à disposition (par exemple, un gestionnaire d’emploi du temps). Dans ce cadre, le jumeau numérique organisationnel représente le système qui permet une simulation et une aide à la prise de décision par des échanges bidirectionnels entre l’organisation physique (personnes et systèmes dont les bâtiments) et sa réplique virtuelle dans un objectif de pilotage global des flux.
Le projet DIGIFAC’Santé s’inscrit dans ce contexte. Il porte sur la conception et le développement d'un jumeau numérique des sites d’une université, de la gestion des flux étudiants et personnels et de l’évolution pédagogique de ses formations.

title: Accounting Close Lead
description:
TL;DR: We're looking for someone who has run a US GAAP close, sat across the table from Big 4 auditors, and wants to build a continuous close where AI does the routine work and people do the thinking. You'll own our month-end close and consolidation process across the US, Sweden and the UK, reporting to our Accounting Controller. You'll build a close designed for scale, with the structure and controls a much bigger company will need built in from the start rather than bolted on later. This is an operating role, not an advisory one.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

The role

Most accounting teams take the close they have today and add AI to it. We'd rather design it from scratch, assuming agents and automation are available, and keep people for review, judgment and the hard calls. Over time we want the close to run continuously rather than as a scramble at month-end.

That only works if the structure underneath is solid. Every automated reconciliation still needs an owner, a review and evidence an auditor can rely on. Every journal entry an agent prepares still needs the right controls around it. You'll be the person who holds both ideas at once: pushing hard on automation while making sure what we build would hold up under SOX.

You'll report to our Accounting Controller, and work alongside a small team. This is a hands-on lead role. You'll own the close, do a lot of the work yourself and help build a legacy with no formal direct reports today.

- Own our month-end close and consolidation process across our US, Swedish and UK entities under US GAAP.

- Partner with the Controller on the move toward a continuous close. Build or direct automated reconciliations, flux analysis and journal entry workflows, and decide where human review actually adds value.

- Design controls, review steps and evidence trails into those workflows from the start, so they're audit-ready without a separate clean-up exercise.

- Support the group external audit for your areas: PBC requests, walkthroughs, reconciliations and support for audit adjustments.

- Assist with the preparation and support of statutory audits in the UK and Sweden.

- Keep close documentation and policies current and clear enough that a new team member or an auditor can follow them.

- Coach the accountants on the team and raise the bar on quality and ownership.
